metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Ivy Overpack
records.biography_en: In The Small Desk Society, Ivy Overpack takes the role of eager schoolbag packer. “I brought all of Tuesday.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: compact school satchel bulging with one visible exercise book.

records.name: Bram Pencilbreak
records.biography_en: In The Small Desk Society, Bram Pencilbreak takes the role of frustrated pencil owner. “It was fine one line ago.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one short broken pencil, two blunt pieces held together.

records.name: Theo Lunchswap
records.biography_en: In The Small Desk Society, Theo Lunchswap takes the role of hopeful lunchbox trader. “I'll swap for something triangular.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small open lunchbox with one triangular sandwich inside.

records.name: Nell Eraserstack
records.biography_en: In The Small Desk Society, Nell Eraserstack takes the role of meticulous eraser collector. “The top one is for emergencies.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: three rounded multicolored erasers stacked in hand.

records.name: Len Rulerbridge
records.biography_en: In The Small Desk Society, Len Rulerbridge takes the role of imaginative school tinkerer. “I measured a way across.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: two short wooden rulers fastened as a tiny bridge.

records.name: Gus Bellwait
records.biography_en: In The Small Desk Society, Gus Bellwait takes the role of impatient recess watcher. “It has been almost time for ages.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: tiny blank clock face on a simple wrist strap raised near face.
